blocks.text: Extending its commitment to community welfare, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over ChariTimba food packs to the Lone District of Occidental Mindoro and mobility aids to the Municipality of Dingalan, Aurora, under its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program on October 28, 2026. PCSO General Manager Melquiades A. Robles led the turnover ceremony, together with Chairperson Retired Judge Felix Reyes, Board Member Imelda Papin, and Chief of Staff Jeremy Regino. Congressman Leody Tarriela received the ChariTimba units on behalf of Occidental Mindoro, while Municipal Administrator Shiela Taay represented the Municipality of Dingalan, Aurora, in receiving the mobility aids.
